ta_read.text: SPY's daily swings show mixed swings (a range); the last structure break was down on Nov 5, when it closed below $750.36. On weekly bars it is in a sideways (between its 10- and 40-week averages), and the weekly swings show higher highs and higher lows.

Price is inside a zone at $759.01–$761.78 where it turned 2 times, most recently on Oct 16; the nearest support zone is $752.87–$758.79, where price turned 6 times, most recently on Oct 23, a former resistance that flipped to support; the nearest resistance zone is $772.11–$777.44, where price turned 8 times, most recently on Nov 4.
Over the last 25 sessions there were 7 distribution days (down on rising volume) and 2 accumulation days (up on rising volume); the last move (+1.3%) came on light volume.
RSI is 50 (neutral), with a bearish divergence on Nov 4: price made a higher high but RSI made a lower one: momentum is not confirming the rise; MACD is below its signal line since Oct 15.
A daily close above $777.44 would clear the nearest resistance and confirm strength; a close below $752.87 would break the nearest support and confirm weakness. Direction is not predicted.
